description: T6-4 (docs/test-campaigns/phase-12.md): the watch rebuild is no longer awaited (broadcast from a done-callback) but still goes to the dedicated max_workers=1 executor. Expected to SURVIVE: the single worker queues rebuilds, so they still never overlap. This records that max_workers=1 alone serializes rebuilds. If this spec starts reporting 'killed', the executor has gained workers and the await is now the only thing keeping rebuilds apart.

target.replace:
_rebuild = loop.run_in_executor(
                executor, _build_static_graph, root, meta_cache, predicted_ctx
            )
            _rebuild.add_done_callback(
                lambda f: f.cancelled()
                or f.exception() is not None
                or f.result() is None
                or asyncio.ensure_future(
                    broadcast(protocol.make_static_graph(f.result()), connections)
                )
            )
            graph = None
